paragraphs: He is mentioned in the Mekhilta, Yitro, in the section “And Moses said to his father-in-law”: he asked Rabban Gamliel. And see the entry R' Yehuda bar Gamda.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The cross-reference to Yehuda bar Gamda does not establish identity with untitled Yehuda of Kfar Akko; its title remains R'. Historical machine גמרא/ד׳ differs from supplied גמדא/ר׳. An indexed רבי alias does not add a title to the heading.

פ׳ ויאמר משה לחותנו identifies the named section opening without edition or modern numbering. Full רבן is preserved for Gamliel; no selection of which Gamliel is implied. Neither citation nor cross-reference is freshly verified.
